Professionally hosted by Whitni & Langston

Welcome to The Grand Nash a luxury, stylish stay in the heart of downtown Nashville designed for unforgettable vibes. Perfect for girls’ trips, couples, or a chic getaway.

Enjoy:
• Rooftop pool & lounge
• Private balcony with city views
• Two convertible sofa beds

Walk to Broadway and relax in style your premium Nashville experience starts here.

The space
The Grand Nash Experience

The Grand Nash is thoughtfully designed with a Nashville-inspired theme, created to fully immerse you in the spirit of the city.

Every detail from the colors and décor to the city views and curated amenities has been carefully selected to reflect the energy, culture, and charm of Nashville.

We invite our guests to arrive with the mindset of embracing the experience to not just visit Nashville, but to truly feel like a part of it.

At The Grand Nash, you don’t just stay… you experience Nashville.

Guest access
At The Grand Nash, your stay is designed for comfort, convenience, and elevated vibes ✨

Guests will enjoy access to:

🚗 Complimentary Parking
One free parking space included with your stay

🏙 Rooftop Skylounge & Pool
• Lounge seating + dining areas
• TVs for entertainment
• Direct access to rooftop pool

🏋🏽‍♀️ Fitness & Business Amenities
• Fully equipped fitness center
• Conference/workspace area

🛒 Lobby Mini Mart
Grab snacks, drinks, and essentials right in the building

Everything is designed to make your stay seamless, stylish, and unforgettable.

Other things to note
🚪 Accessing & Securing Your Unit

To Unlock the Door:
	1.	Scan your key fob
	2.	Turn the lock to the left
	3.	Push down on the door handle to enter

To Secure the Door:
	1.	Scan your key fob
	2.	Turn the lock to the right
	3.	Push down on the door handle to confirm it is locked

Important House Notes:

• No parties or events allowed
• No smoking, vaping, or e-cigarettes inside
• Quiet hours are 10 PM – 7 AM
• No shoes on the living room carpet
• Maximum of 4 guests
• Please respect the space and neighbors

Failure to follow house rules may result in additional fees.
